name: Admin Client Create Standalone
description: Create a new client profile from /panel/clients via the compact modal form, with and without email. The canonical profile stores contact name, company/legal name, real or placeholder email, phone, NIT or personal C.C., address and billing code. The selected document type saves a C.C. in cedula instead of nit. These fields supply the same billing_customer projection consumed by new cuentas de cobro.
